author: Tom Nicholas
description:
In 1969, the UK government decided to lower the minimum voting age for elections from 18 to 16.

It was a major move which enfranchised hundreds of thousands of additional new, young voters.

Now, Keir Starmer and the current Labour government are looking to go one step further and give the vote to 16 and 17 year olds too.

What do you think? Should 16 and 17 year olds be able to vote?
title: How 18 Year Olds Got the Vote
